value: Mean depth over the MUC1 VNTR: 20x. At that depth (below 50x) VNtyper found the known variant in 48 of 109 runs (44%), in VNtyper 2.0.47's downsampling of 42 confirmed positive GRCh38 exomes (repeated runs, not independent tests).
VNtyper calls no frameshift, but its coverage check is FAIL (20x over the VNTR, 50x is its floor on GRCh38), so a frameshift cannot be ruled out.

A negative here lowers the chance of the frameshifts VNtyper looks for; it does not rule ADTKD-MUC1 out. A family history of kidney failure with gout or a bland urine sediment still deserves a clinical test (SNaPshot for dupC).
